Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick note and the attachments. Two quick things to rule out:
1) Can you confirm the PIN you're entering matches the one in the invite email (there's a visual space sometimes introduced when forwarding)?
2) If you request a new PIN, please wait ~90s before entering it — we've seen some mobile clients submit a stale token if the request is retried too quickly.

On our side I looked up your tenant (tenant id: tenant-84b7) — there was a recent routing change we rolled last week that may cause a token to be validated against an old edge cache for certain regions. I'm escalating to Ben for the infra side.

If that doesn't work, I can do a manual activation for the account. For manual activation I need the legal business name and EIN (feel free to confirm in a reply).

Workaround doc: https://redwood.ai/support/portal-activation-troubleshooting (screenshot guide). I'll also attach a one-off token generator instruction set to this thread.

Best,
